en-UK.name: Beilu Files
en-UK.description: Sandboxed file operations for AI — read, write, create, search.
en-UK.description_markdown: **Beilu Files** provides a sandboxed file operation system. The AI can read, write, create, and search files via `<file_op>` XML tags. Whitelist-based security with delete confirmation.
en-UK.author: 凛倾

zh-CN.name: 文件操作
zh-CN.description: 沙箱化文件操作 — AI 读写、创建、搜索文件
zh-CN.description_markdown: **文件操作** 提供沙箱化的文件操作系统。AI 通过 `<file_op>` XML 标签进行文件读写、创建和搜索。基于白名单的安全机制，删除需用户确认。
zh-CN.author: 凛倾
